pages.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
29th November 1916

Sir,
Thirty two rebel leaders visited Dr. Sun Yat Sen yesterday and requested him to take steps to induce the Government to refund them money which they had spent in the public cause. Dr. Sun refused to have anything to do with the matter.
The troops at Lungwha, the Arsenal and Woosung were paid on 27th and 28th instant.
Owing to lack of funds, the Director of the Arsenal intends to discharge some of the workmen on 1st prox.
Huang Hsin's funeral will take place on 23rd prox.
Tsen Tsun Huan 岑春煊 ex-Commander of the Republican troops in Canton and Kwangsi, arrived from Canton yesterday and is staying in a house in Sing Ming Lee 新民里 alleyway, Rue Paul Beau. It is reported that the local merchants and officials are planning an entertainment in his honour.

Your obedient servant,
MB new man /
Detective Sub Inspector.

Chief Detective Inspector.
pages.zh:
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）
1916年11月29日

先生：

昨日有三十二名叛乱首领拜访孙中山博士，请求他采取措施，促使政府偿还他们为公共事业所花费的款项。孙博士拒绝介入此事。

龙华、兵工厂及吴淞的部队已于本月27日和28日发放薪饷。

由于资金短缺，兵工厂总监打算于下月1日遣散部分工人。

黄兴的葬礼将于下月23日举行。

前广东、广西共和军司令岑春煊昨日从广州抵达，现寓居宝昌路新民里弄堂内的一处住宅。据报，当地商人和官员正计划为他举行招待活动。

您顺从的仆人，
MB new man /
侦探副巡官。

首席侦探巡官。
